CALLER_PARAMETER: Actual decimal HOST_CALLER_PID plus verified /proc/PID/stat starttime and boot identity, supplied by operator; do not choose inspection self PID
CALLSITE_RECEIPT: Raw hash and exact lines of actual existing operator/launcher invocation; pins of caller executable and child127; explicit standard endpoint objects, closure/CLOEXEC/pass_fds and ordering, process/session topology. Snapshot alone insufficient.
ENVIRONMENT_RECEIPT: Authenticate existing launch configuration assigning exact clean env127; do not dump arbitrary credential-bearing environ. Selected PATH/loader/startup hook evidence may be separately permissioned/redacted; incomplete identity remains UNKNOWN.
EXPECTED_EVIDENCE: caller executable raw pin and uid/gid
0..2 backing objects/modes and all extra fdinfo flags/CLOEXEC
existing callsite preventing unintended inherited capabilities before first exec
LIMITS: No selectable collection subject sealed: actual PID, operator permission, finite collector/output limits and live receipt are missing. Commands are templates, not invented exact executed receipt.
NOT_PROOF_OF_FUTURE_EXEC: Configuration/semantics and fresh same-route guard necessary; process FD snapshot is evidence at capture time only
ORDER: Caller identified/birth checked, read-only snapshot, source/config authenticated, birth rechecked; changed/reused PID, races or incomplete table UNKNOWN. Independently verify fresh entry under same exact route.
PERMISSIONS: Same-user proc reads may be available subject to ptrace/hidepid/policy; verify actual read permission. No sudo/cross-user inference.
READER: Existing independently permitted host operator reads a nominated already-running caller via pinned cat/readlink/ls; independent reviewer verifies raw receipt and launch source/configuration
SCOPE: Host metadata only; no witness/bwrap/unshare/resource changes/protected descriptor opening; no target process signal or exec
SEPARATE_AUTHORITY: Read-only metadata collection only if already independently permitted; otherwise seek scoped permission. Any active descriptor census or launch validation requires separate bounded execution authority.
